Hong Kong Drops Pipeline Damage Case Against Ship Captain

Hong Kong has dropped charges against the captain of a ship accused of causing damage to a Baltic pipeline. The case, which involved an alleged HK$400 million in damages, saw the captain cleared to set sail home. The specific details of the pipeline damage and the captain's alleged involvement were not elaborated upon in the provided coverage.
